title: Self-healing X16: the loop builds T1 pipeline-repair items in a normal repair cycle, and T0 items go to the operator queue
summary: Today a pipeline defect gets a console fix (docs/operations/operating-policy.md:70-72); 62 pipeline-repair items are in the inbox, 18 routed to the console and 44 with no route. The tiers are the staged path from console-first to a loop that repairs T1. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §18, §20.2 and §22.
fix: An accepted open-repair-item proposal creates an item with its tier. A T1 item runs scout, TDD (a red test that reproduces the incident), build, audit with another family, a mutation gate on changed functions, and ship. A T0 item goes to the console queue as a proposal. Stage keys healing.T1.stage and healing.T2.stage start at shadow and flip only by an operator change on the measured rates.
acceptance: RED first: a T0 pipeline-repair item reaches a loop lane today; after the change the plan refuses it and routes it to the console
A T1 repair cycle needs a red reproduction test before build
The incident closes only when the four I-14 conditions hold, and a recovery retrospective exists (ADR-0151)
In shadow the loop records the proposal and the console does the repair
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §20.2 and the operating policy updated
